key.description: The object's key, such as reports/2026-q3.csv.

content.description: The object's text, sent as UTF-8; at most the endpoint's request size.

contentType.description: A text media type, such as text/csv or application/json.

metadata.description: User metadata, sent as x-amz-meta-<name> headers: lower-case names, printable ASCII values.

overwrite.description: false: only create the object; nothing changes when the key already holds one.

ifMatch.description: Replace the object only while its ETag is this one (from s3_head_object).

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
